const trigger = $('Normalize AI Draft Trigger').first().json;
const task = $('Get Clinical Task').first()?.json ?? {};
const historyRow = $('Get Patient History').first()?.json ?? {};

if (!task.id || !task.patient_id) {
  throw new Error('No se pudo recuperar la tarea clínica solicitada.');
}

const history = historyRow?.data && typeof historyRow.data === 'object'
  ? historyRow.data
  : {};

const safeHistory = {
  diabetesType: history.diabetesType ?? null,
  diagnosisYear: history.diagnosisYear ?? null,
  conditionsStatus: history.conditionsStatus ?? null,
  conditions: Array.isArray(history.conditions) ? history.conditions : [],
  severeLowHistory: history.severeLowHistory ?? null,
  treatmentStatus: history.treatmentStatus ?? null,
  medications: Array.isArray(history.medications)
    ? history.medications.map((m) => ({
        name: m?.name ?? null,
        dose: m?.dose ?? null,
        schedule: m?.schedule ?? null
      }))
    : [],
  allergyStatus: history.allergyStatus ?? null,
  allergies: history.allergies ?? null,
  activity: history.activity ?? null,
  notes: history.notes ?? null
};

const readings = $('Get Glucose Readings').all()
  .map((i) => i.json)
  .filter((r) => r?.id)
  .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.measured_at || 0) - new Date(a.measured_at || 0))
  .slice(0, 20)
  .map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    glucose_value: r.glucose_value,
    unit: r.unit,
    measurement_context: r.measurement_context,
    measured_at: r.measured_at,
    measurement_source: r.measurement_source,
    has_eaten: r.has_eaten,
    meal_type: r.meal_type,
    carbohydrate_estimate: r.carbohydrate_estimate,
    treatment_due_before_measurement: r.treatment_due_before_measurement,
    treatment_taken_as_scheduled: r.treatment_taken_as_scheduled,
    recent_physical_activity: r.recent_physical_activity,
    activity_duration_min: r.activity_duration_min,
    activity_intensity: r.activity_intensity,
    symptoms_present: r.symptoms_present,
    symptoms: r.symptoms,
    illness_flag: r.illness_flag,
    stress_flag: r.stress_flag,
    sleep_quality: r.sleep_quality,
    observation: r.observation,
    quality_state: r.quality_state
  }));

const dailyContext = $('Get Daily Context').all()
  .map((i) => i.json)
  .filter((r) => r?.id)
  .sort((a, b) => String(b.local_date || '').localeCompare(String(a.local_date || '')))
  .slice(0, 7)
  .map((r) => ({
    local_date: r.local_date,
    treatment_adherence_24h: r.treatment_adherence_24h,
    missed_doses_7d: r.missed_doses_7d,
    missed_dose_reason: r.missed_dose_reason,
    illness_flag: r.illness_flag,
    stress_flag: r.stress_flag,
    sleep_quality: r.sleep_quality
  }));

const adherence = $('Get Adherence Summary').all()
  .map((i) => i.json)
  .filter((r) => r?.id)
  .sort((a, b) => String(b.period_end_date || '').localeCompare(String(a.period_end_date || '')))
  .slice(0, 6)
  .map((r) => ({
    window_days: r.window_days,
    period_end_date: r.period_end_date,
    days_with_reading: r.days_with_reading,
    total_readings: r.total_readings,
    adherence_pct: r.adherence_pct,
    readings_per_week: r.readings_per_week,
    max_gap_days: r.max_gap_days,
    days_since_last_reading: r.days_since_last_reading,
    abandoned_flag: r.abandoned_flag,
    completeness_pct: r.completeness_pct,
    slot_coverage_pct: r.slot_coverage_pct
  }));

const alerts = $('Get Patient Alerts').all()
  .map((i) => i.json)
  .filter((r) => r?.id)
  .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.created_at || 0))
  .slice(0, 10)
  .map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    alert_type: r.alert_type,
    severity: r.severity,
    status: r.status,
    reason: r.reason,
    created_at: r.created_at
  }));

const sourceRegistry = [
  { source_key: 'TASK', description: 'Tarea clínica actual (clinical_tasks).' },
  ...(historyRow?.patient_id ? [{ source_key: 'HISTORY', description: 'Historia del paciente minimizada (patient_histories).' }] : []),
  ...(readings.length ? [{ source_key: 'READINGS', description: 'Lecturas recientes de glucosa (glucose_readings).' }] : []),
  ...(dailyContext.length ? [{ source_key: 'DAILY_CONTEXT', description: 'Contexto diario reciente (glucose_daily_context).' }] : []),
  ...(adherence.length ? [{ source_key: 'ADHERENCE', description: 'Resumen de adherencia (adherence_summary).' }] : []),
  ...(alerts.length ? [{ source_key: 'ALERTS', description: 'Alertas recientes (alerts).' }] : [])
];

return [{
  json: {
    ...trigger,
    clinical_task_id: task.id,
    patient_id: task.patient_id,
    task,
    patient_history: safeHistory,
    glucose_readings: readings,
    daily_context: dailyContext,
    adherence_summary: adherence,
    alerts,
    source_registry: sourceRegistry
  }
}];
